kebab_example: aliyun eas update-service-rollout --cluster-id cn-shanghai --service-name my-service --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateServiceRollout

parameters.help_en:
ClusterId  
Type: string
Required: yes
Description: The region ID. The identifier of the region where the service is deployed.
Example: cn-shanghai
parameters.help_zh:
ClusterId  
类型: string
必填: 是
说明: 地域ID。服务所在的地域标识。
示例值: cn-shanghai
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
ServiceName  
Type: string
Required: yes
Description: The service name. The name of the service whose rollout policy you want to update.
Example: my-service
parameters.help_zh:
ServiceName  
类型: string
必填: 是
说明: 服务名称。要更新发布策略的服务名称。
示例值: my-service
parameters.name: service_name

fields.help_en: The batch size. The number of replicas to update in each batch. Integer or percentage formats are supported. Default value: `"25%"`
fields.help_zh: 批次大小。每批次更新的副本数量。支持整数或百分比格式。默认值：`"25%"`
fields.name: batch_size

fields.help_en: The batch interval. The wait time between two rollouts. Supported units: `s` (seconds), `m` (minutes), and `h` (hours)
fields.help_zh: 批次间隔。两次发布之间的等待时间。支持单位：`s`（秒）、`m`（分钟）、`h`（小时）
fields.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
Batch  
Type: object
Required: no
Description: The batch rollout configuration. Used to adjust batch policy parameters. Mutually exclusive with Partition
parameters.help_zh:
Batch  
类型: object
必填: 否
说明: 批量发布配置。用于调整批量策略参数。与Partition互斥
parameters.name: batch

fields.help_en:
Partition  
Type: string
Required: yes
Description: The partition value. Two formats are supported:
Integer format: such as "5", which indicates that 5 old replicas are retained.
Percentage format: such as "50%", which indicates that 50% of the old replicas are retained.
  Adjustment strategies:
Increase the value: Roll back to the old version and increase the proportion of old replicas.
Decrease the value: Proceed to the new version and decrease the proportion of old replicas.
Set to "0%": Complete the full update and switch all replicas to the new version.
Example: 30%
fields.help_zh:
Partition  
类型: string
必填: 是
说明: 分区值。支持两种格式：
整数格式：如 "5"，表示保留5个旧副本
百分比格式：如 "50%"，表示保留50%的旧副本
  调整策略：
调大值：回退到旧版本，增加旧副本比例
调小值：推进到新版本，减少旧副本比例
设置为"0%"：完成全部更新，所有副本切换到新版本
示例值: 30%
fields.name: partition

parameters.help_en:
Partition  
Type: object
Required: no
Description: The partition rollout configuration. Used to adjust partition policy parameters. Mutually exclusive with Batch
parameters.help_zh:
Partition  
类型: object
必填: 否
说明: 分区发布配置。用于调整分区策略参数。与Batch互斥
parameters.name: partition

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to pause the rollout. A value of `true` indicates that the rollout is paused. A value of `false` indicates that the rollout is resumed
parameters.help_zh: 是否暂停发布。`true`表示暂停，`false`表示恢复
parameters.name: paused

Message.description_en:
The returned message. Describes the request processing result. Valid values:
"Rollout updated successfully": The rollout policy is updated.
"Rollout paused successfully": The rollout is paused.
"Rollout resumed successfully": The rollout is resumed
Message.description_zh:
返回信息。描述请求处理结果。可能值：
"Rollout updated successfully"：更新策略成功
"Rollout paused successfully"：暂停发布成功
"Rollout resumed successfully"：恢复发布成功
